text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: INFR-9234 — inference-pool-eu high 5xx rate (auto-escalate)
SRE-Janet: acked. I'm taking first pass. pinging logs and metrics now. @oncall-sam if you're able to join bridge?
oncall-sam: on it, joining :headphones: — joining bridge in 30s
ops-tariq: saw a small surge from customer X (api-key: cx_***) ~10m ago, might be malformed payloads. throttling rules didn't trigger.
cs-lucy: Customer X reporting "fast failures" on their side — they sent a few error screenshots. CS reached out to request ETA.
SRE-Janet: quick triage — running tail on api-gateway and inference-proxy:
```
kubectl logs -n prod inference-proxy-7f4d -c proxy | grep "5xx" | tail -n 20
2025-05-22T14:02:13Z ERROR request_id=... 502 upstream read timeout
2025-05-22T14:02:18Z ERROR request_id=... 503 model-worker OOM
```
infra-nick: model-worker OOMs line up with autoscaler cooldown. GPU pool didn't spin up new nodes because quota hit in eu-west-1.
SRE-Janet: ok, hypothesis: sudden customer burst + autoscaler quota = model-worker OOMs -> 5xxs. Immediate mitigation options: (A) failover routing to dedicated fallback model in us-east, (B) bump pool via emergency quota, (C) temporary soft-limit on large requests for affected customers.
oncall-sam: I'll take handoff to coordinate routing (A). I'm going to flip the routing policy for customer X to a smaller-model variant and route non-critical traffic to us-east fallback. Doing step-by-step and will post commands.
ops-tariq: I'll open a support quota request with cloud and try to provision a spare GPU node in eu region (low-latency option) — ETA 12-15m if approved.
cs-lucy: telling Customer X we're working on a mitigation and might route some requests to a fallback — asking if that'd be acceptable for them temporarily.
SRE-Janet: sam, run the routing change and post the exact commands so we can audit. also add a temporary rule to rate-limit large sequences for that api-key.
oncall-sam: executing now:
```
# flip routing for api-key cx_*** to model:small-variant and fallback: us-east-small
redwoodctl routing update --key cx_*** --primary small-variant-eu --fallback small-variant-us-east --force
# apply soft rate-limit
redwoodctl quota set --key cx_*** --max-tokens 1024 --burst 2
```
oncall-sam: done. routing change accepted by control plane. new routing applied to ~4k requests/minute for that key. :white_check_mark:
SRE-Janet: watching downstream — reducing OOMs. metrics show 40% drop in model OOM errors in last 60s.
infra-nick: cloud quota requested. created ticket CLOUD-7781, escalated to support. link: https://cloud.example/tickets/CLOUD-7781
ops-tariq: started provisioning spare node as preemptible. progress: provisioning -> bootstrapping -> attaching volumes.
SRE-Janet: customer impact assessment: initial spike affected ~2% of requests for Customer X, ~150 failed requests total during the 10m window. No broader customer rollup yet.
cs-lucy: Customer X accepted fallback routing for now, appreciates the update. asked for an ETA for full restoration.
SRE-Janet: ETA: if quota approved, +12m for node + warmup -> full capacity. If not, we keep fallback routing and consider longer term auto-scaler tuning.
oncall-sam: posting status ping to PD and adding note to incident ticket. will re-evaluate in 10m. @sre-janet please confirm if we should escalate to oncall lead.
SRE-Janet: if CLOUD-7781 isn't approved in 10m escalate to eng-lead. also start a post-incident action: autoscaler should account for burst headroom and quota failures in decision tree.
ops-tariq: spare node attached and workers are registering. warmup log:
```
worker-attach: success
model-serve: loaded small-variant 3.2s
kv-cache warmup: 8s
```
SRE-Janet: monitoring latency and 5xx. 5xx rate down to baseline. passing to sam to keep watch for ripple.
oncall-sam: holding bridge for 20m, will ping every 5m. leaving routing in fallback mode until further notice. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
cs-lucy: Customer X confirmed degraded but acceptable, would like final postmortem notes when done.
SRE-Janet: documented actions: routing fallback applied, soft rate-limit applied, spare node provisioned, quota escalate filed. Owner: SRE-Janet. Action items: follow up autoscaler tuning, review quota failure handling, notify customers impacted in PSR.
incident-bot: note added to INFR-9234: "temporary routing fallback + spare node provisioned; customer X impacted ~2% requests; monitoring stable" — closing PD alert in 30m unless further pages.
oncall-sam: thanks team. if anything flares, ping here. otherwise I'll close the bridge after 20m and update the ticket. :v:
SRE-Janet: thanks everyone. we'll run a short postmortem and follow-ups tomorrow. good catch on the payload surge pattern — ops and cs, please share payload samples in secure channel for analysis.
ops-tariq: ACK — will upload sanitized payload samples to private S3 and link in the incident ticket.
cs-lucy: copying Customer X consent for sharing. will add to ticket.
SRE-Janet: closing notes: incident severity reduced to S2, no SLA breach at org level. will keep incident open for follow-ups."
